## Interpretation boundary

This spike validates the persistence-tooling seam, including SQLite STRICT tables, connection-level foreign-key enforcement, application transactions, dialect-specific FTS isolation, portable UUID storage, named constraints, Alembic migration behavior, and PostgreSQL execution of the same Core metadata model.

It does not yet define the complete production schema or authorize use of SQLAlchemy ORM as the domain model.
